title: Better than square-root cancellation and Gaussian behavior on Piatetski-Shapiro Sequences
summary: In this paper, we investigate whether Harper's better than square-root cancellation phenomenon still appears in Piatetski-Shapiro sequences, and when one should expect only square-root size.
